blocks.text: Specification: select_latest(rows) takes a list of tuples (key, revision, status, value). Keys and status are strings; revision and value are integers. Only status == 'approved' is eligible. For each key choose the eligible row with greatest revision; tied revision uses the smaller value. Return a list of (key, value) sorted by key. A key without an approved row is omitted. Do not mutate rows. Empty input returns []. Status comparisons are case sensitive. No imports are needed.

cases.question: Write a readable, complete Python implementation of select_latest(rows). Then supply at least six top-level assert examples covering empty input, one key, newer unapproved rows, revision ties, multiple keys in sorted order, and case-sensitive status. Include one or two concise explanatory comments for the selection rules and label each test with a comment. Use explicit loops and comparisons; avoid imports, attributes, decorators, classes, comprehensions and I/O. Allowed calls are select_latest, sorted, len, min and max. Output one Python code block only, with the function and all six tests; do not use ellipses or replace examples with prose.

manual: Functionality against all selection, tie, sorting and nonmutation requirements must be reviewed manually; no generated code is executed.

blocks.text: 函数合同：approved_totals(rows, cutoff) 接收记录列表，每条为 (project, revision, status, amount)。project/status 为字符串，revision/amount/cutoff 为整数；amount 非负。只考虑 status == 'approved' 且 revision <= cutoff。按项目取最大合格 revision；同一 revision 重复时取最小 amount。返回按项目字典序排列的 (project, amount) 列表；无合格记录的项目省略，空输入返回 []，不得修改输入。例：[("p",1,"approved",8),("p",3,"draft",99),("p",2,"approved",7)]，cutoff=2 时应返回 [("p",7)]。

cases.question: 给出完整可读的 Python 函数 approved_totals(rows, cutoff)，以及至少六个顶层 assert 示例，分别覆盖空输入、截止日期之前无记录、较新草稿、修订号相同取小金额、多项目排序和给定例子。用中文注释解释筛选顺序、同版本规则与每个测试目的。使用显式循环/比较，不用导入、属性访问、装饰器、类、推导式或输入输出；只允许调用 approved_totals、sorted、len、min、max。只输出一个 Python 代码块，包含函数和全部六个实际测试，不能用省略号。

blocks.text: 正式事件记录甲：模拟文档服务代号纸鹤。09:10 发布索引配置 R17；09:14 监控首先发现检索延迟上升。影响窗口为09:14至09:32，共18分钟。该窗口共有240次检索，其中36次超时；写入服务始终可用。
正式事件记录乙：值班员林澄在09:20开始回滚，并于09:25完成回滚到R16；缓存预热后09:32指标恢复。抽查120份文档未发现内容丢失，但本次抽查不能证明全量文档零丢失。根因尚未确认，索引配置与延迟的关联仍是待验证假设。
正式事件记录丙：10月12日由陈桥补充配置校验测试，10月13日由许禾验证告警阈值。后续禁止在根因结论中把相关性写成因果性；需要另做受控复现。没有决定永久停用该服务，也没有宣布全量数据已完成核验。

[正式摘录甲]
清晨的保管员先打开东侧窗户，再把昨日归还的地图平放在长桌上。他逐一核对封套编号，将边角卷起的三张地图移到修复架，随后在蓝色登记册中写明位置与日期。尚未核对的材料仍留在原箱，不能提前标记为完成。
[/正式摘录甲]

[正式摘录乙]
午后的整理工作从第二排书架开始。两名志愿者按照书脊上的编号逐册检查，并把缺少封面的册子单独登记。负责人要求先记录观察到的事实，再讨论修补方案；无法确认的年份保留问号，不凭相邻册子的年代补写。
[/正式摘录乙]

[正式摘录丙]
闭馆前，值班员检查门窗与工作灯，确认登记册已经放回抽屉。他将待处理材料的清单交给下一班同事，清楚注明已核对与未核对的部分。最后一次巡查只覆盖开放阅览区，因此记录中没有声称全部库房都已检查。
[/正式摘录丙]

cases.question: 找到正式摘录甲、乙、丙，按甲乙丙顺序逐字抄写三个完整正文段落。去掉方括号标签，每段之间仅留一个空行。不要改字、删句、添加标题、解释、引号或代码块；最后一段之后不要加额外内容。

[OFFICIAL EXCERPT A]
At opening time, the keeper placed the returned maps on the long table beside the east window. She checked each folder number against the blue register and moved three curled sheets to the repair shelf. Materials that had not yet been checked remained in their original box. The register described only the work actually completed that morning, with a separate note for every unresolved label.
[/OFFICIAL EXCERPT A]

[OFFICIAL EXCERPT B]
The afternoon team began with the second row of shelves. Two volunteers compared the numbers on the book spines and recorded missing covers on a separate sheet. Their supervisor asked them to write down observations before proposing repairs. If a publication year could not be established from the volume itself, they kept a question mark rather than copying a date from the neighboring book.
[/OFFICIAL EXCERPT B]

[OFFICIAL EXCERPT C]
Before closing, the attendant checked the windows and work lamps, then returned the register to its drawer. He handed the next shift a list distinguishing verified materials from items still awaiting inspection. The final walk covered the public reading room only. Accordingly, his note did not claim that every storage room had been inspected, and it preserved the remaining checks for the following morning.
[/OFFICIAL EXCERPT C]
